extDescription.message: MCP sunucuları için tam yetkili tarayıcı köprüsü: DOM, sekmeler, ağ, konsol, CDP.

statusRejected.description: Status badge when the MCP server does not trust this extension's id

statusDisconnected.description: Status badge when the MCP server closed the connection for another reason (for example a handshake timeout)

statusPairedTitle.description: Status badge tooltip when the server completed the handshake

statusHandshakeTitle.message: Bağlandı, MCP sunucusunun el sıkışması bekleniyor
statusHandshakeTitle.description: Status badge tooltip while connected but the server handshake is pending

tabRecentCommands.description: Navigation tab for the command history pane

permsAgentNote.description: Hint under the permission search: the agent can only disable permissions

langAuto.description: Language option that follows the browser's language (no emoji or icon)

statusActionNeeded.description: Status badge when this browser has to pair with the MCP server again (new pairing offer, rejected pairing proof or pairing closed)

statusUntrustedServer.description: Status badge when the program on the port could not prove it is the paired MCP server

statusUpdateNeeded.description: Status badge when the extension and MCP server protocol versions differ

pairInfoHandshake.description: Pairing status line while the server is being verified

pairInfoNoKey.description: Pairing status line when this browser has never been paired

pairInfoNoKeyTitle.message: Eşleştirme öneren ilk MCP sunucusuna otomatik olarak güvenilir.
pairInfoNoKeyTitle.description: Tooltip of the not-paired status line (trust on first use)

serverVersionLabel.description: Prefix before the MCP server version number (e.g. "Server v0.3.5")

btnForgetPairing.description: Small action that deletes the stored pairing key

forgetPairingTitle.message: Bu tarayıcının eşleştirme anahtarını siler ve yeniden bağlanır. Eşleştirme öneren bir sonraki MCP sunucusuna otomatik olarak güvenilir.

btnRepair.description: Button that accepts the next pairing offer from the server

btnRepairing.description: Re-pair button label while waiting for the server

repairTitle.message: Sunucunun bir sonraki eşleştirme önerisini (2 dakika boyunca) kabul et ve şimdi yeniden bağlan

menuTitle.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the header button (⋯) that opens the settings menu

menuExtension.description: Settings menu section: this extension's version and ID

menuPort.description: Settings menu section: the local port the extension uses to reach the MCP server

menuLanguage.description: Settings menu section: the popup language

menuPairing.description: Settings menu section: re-pair with or forget the MCP server pairing

agentTabsNone.description: Status line under the header: the agent works in no tab (lower case, it follows a separator)

agentTabsOne.description: Status line under the header: the agent works in one tab

agentTabsMany.description: Status line under the header: number of tabs the agent works in. Keep {n} unchanged: it is replaced by the number (2 or more)

agentTabsTitle.description: Heading of the list of tabs the agent works in (click a tab to switch to it)

activityNow.description: Live activity strip: label before the command the agent is running right now. Include the colon, with your language's spacing (French: "En cours :")

activityMore.description: Live activity strip: how many other commands are running at the same time. Keep {n} unchanged: it is replaced by the number

profileRead.description: Permission profile (short button label): read-only access

profileReadDesc.message: Sayfaları gezme, okuma ve ekran görüntüsü alma. Tıklama ya da yazma yapılmaz.
profileReadDesc.description: Description of the Read permission profile

profileStandard.description: Permission profile (short button label): everything except high-risk access

profileStandardDesc.message: Ek olarak tıklama, yazma, ağ ve geliştirici araçları. Yüksek riskli erişim yok.
profileStandardDesc.description: Description of the Standard permission profile

profileFull.description: Permission profile (short button label): every permission on

profileFullDesc.message: Kod çalıştırma, çerezler, depolama ve geçmiş dahil her şey.
profileFullDesc.description: Description of the Full permission profile

profileCustom.description: Permission profile (short button label): shown when the switches match no profile; not clickable

profileCustomDesc.description: Description shown when the permission switches match no profile

riskHigh.description: Small badge on permission categories that can reach private data or run code

confirmHighRiskTitle.message: Yüksek riskli erişime izin verilsin mi?
confirmHighRiskTitle.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before switching on high-risk permissions

confirmHighRiskBody.message: Ajan şunları kullanabilecek: {cats}. Bunlar oturum açma bilgileri, çerezler, depolama, pano ve geçmiş gibi özel verileri okuyabilir veya değiştirebilir ya da sayfalarda herhangi bir kodu çalıştırabilir.
confirmHighRiskBody.description: Body of the high-risk confirmation dialog. Keep {cats} unchanged: it is replaced by a comma-separated list of permission category names

confirmAllow.description: Confirmation dialog button that switches the high-risk permissions on

confirmCancel.description: Confirmation dialog button that closes the dialog without changing anything

confirmForgetTitle.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before deleting the pairing key

confirmForgetBody.message: Bu tarayıcıdaki eşleştirme anahtarı silinir. Yeniden bağlanmak için sunucuyu bir kez --pair ile başlatın.
confirmForgetBody.description: Body of the forget-pairing confirmation dialog; keep --pair unchanged

agentDisabledBadge.description: Small badge next to a permission the AI agent switched off itself

agentDisabledHint.message: Bunu ajan kapattı. Yalnızca siz yeniden açabilirsiniz.

stopAll.description: Footer button that switches every permission off and cancels running commands

stopAllHint.message: Tüm izinleri kapat ve çalışan komutları iptal et
stopAllHint.description: Tooltip of the Stop agent button

stopAllDone.description: Stop agent button label for a moment after it switched everything off

historyFilterAll.description: History filter chip: show every command

historyFilterErrors.description: History filter chip: show only failed commands

historyNoErrors.description: History list text when the Errors filter matches nothing

historyUnknownSite.description: History group heading for commands that did not act on a web page

catDesc_downloads.description: One-line description of the Downloads permission category

catDesc_bookmarks.message: Yer işareti arama, ekleme ve kaldırma

catDesc_sessions.message: Kapatılan sekmeleri geri yükleme, oturum durumunu kaydetme ve yükleme

catDesc_browsing_data.description: One-line description of the Browsing Data permission category

catDesc_notifications.description: One-line description of the Notifications permission category

catDesc_emulation.message: Cihaz, ekran, CPU ve konum emülasyonu
catDesc_emulation.description: One-line description of the Emulation permission category

catDesc_performance.message: Sayfa hızını ölçme ve performans izi kaydetme
catDesc_performance.description: One-line description of the Performance permission category

catDesc_system.description: One-line description of the System permission category

pairedShort.description: Short pairing state in the line under the popup header (the full text is its tooltip)

noticeUnknownServerTitle.description: Notice title when the program on the bridge port could not prove it is the paired MCP server. Same words as the matching help heading

noticeUnknownServerBody.message: Bu porttaki program, eşleştirdiğiniz sunucu değil. Hiçbir komut çalıştırılmadı.
noticeUnknownServerBody.description: Notice text for an unknown server: it is not the paired server and nothing was run. Keep it as short as the English; no file names or settings

noticeRepairTitle.description: Notice title when this browser has to pair with the MCP server again; the notice shows the Re-pair button

noticeRepairBody.description: Notice text next to the Re-pair button: pair again only if the user reset the server. One short sentence

noticeAuthFailedBody.message: Eşleştirmeyi unutun, ardından sunucuyu bir kez --pair ile başlatın.
noticeAuthFailedBody.description: Notice text when the MCP server rejected this browser's pairing proof, next to the Forget pairing button. Keep --pair verbatim. One short sentence

noticePairClosedTitle.description: Notice title when the MCP server accepts no new pairing because it is paired with another install

noticePairClosedBody.description: Notice text when pairing is closed. Keep --pair unchanged: it is a command-line flag. One short sentence

noticeVersionTitle.description: Notice title when the extension and the MCP server use different protocol versions

noticeVersionServer.message: MCP sunucusunu bu eklentinin sürümüne güncelleyin.
noticeVersionServer.description: Version notice text when the MCP server is the older side. One short sentence

noticeVersionExtension.message: Bu eklentiyi MCP sunucusunun sürümüne güncelleyin.
noticeVersionExtension.description: Version notice text when this extension is the older side. One short sentence

noticeVersionBoth.message: Eklentiyi ve MCP sunucusunu aynı sürüme güncelleyin.
noticeVersionBoth.description: Version notice text when it is unknown which side is older. One short sentence

noticeRejectedTitle.description: Notice title when the MCP server does not trust this extension's ID

noticeRejectedBody.message: Bu eklentinin kimliğini sunucunun güvenilen eklentiler listesine ekleyin.
noticeRejectedBody.description: Notice text next to the Copy ID button (btnCopyId): the user adds the copied ID to the server's trusted list. One short sentence

noticeClosedTitle.description: Notice title when the MCP server closed the connection for another reason (the notice has no further text)

btnDetails.description: Link-style button in every notice that opens the matching help section on GitHub

btnCopyId.description: Notice button that copies this extension's ID to the clipboard
